rails.summary: Current KZT P2P market surface exists on OKX and is the strongest Kazakhstan-relevant current rail signal in the reviewed source set.
The reviewed current official sources did not prove a direct KZT deposit or withdrawal rail.
No reviewed current official source proved Kazakhstan-specific bank-card purchase entitlement.
Crypto transfer functionality is part of OKX's platform model, but Kazakhstan legality and product eligibility remain separate questions.
